name: AICTE Approved Polytechnics
evidence: The official AICTE approval endpoint, queried for DIPLOMA-level institutes, returns records explicitly named as polytechnics, supporting classification of this AICTE-approved polytechnic category as vocational training institutes.
notes: The supplied AICTE domain identifies the All India Council for Technical Education and links to the official institute-approval dashboard.
The record is an aggregate category rather than a single campus, so confidence is medium.
Normal TLS verification failed with the exact local self-signed certificate-in-chain proxy error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to official AICTE hostnames.
